verdict.rationale: Weave documents a REST Service API at trace.wandb.ai for programmatic access to Weave functionality. Its live OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec covers the full service surface (117 paths, including call start and stream queries), with a Swagger UI, and Python/TypeScript SDKs handle tracing, evaluations, scorers and costs. However, nothing explicitly states that the API matches everything the UI can do. UI features such as the Playground, leaderboards and alert/webhook configuration have no documented API equivalents in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit UI-to-API parity documentation, API coverage evidence for Playground/leaderboards/alert configuration, a documented API versioning policy, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use the Weave Service API, which provides REST endpoints for programmatic access to Weave functionality.

The Weave trace API host serves a complete machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document at the well-known path, covering the full service surface (117 paths, including /call/start and /calls/stream_query).
The trace API hosts a live Swagger UI that loads /openapi.json, a runnable in-page console against the production API
